text: {"lessons":["My account gained overall without trades, but that does not show that holding unchanged will always be best or that recent gains will continue.","The dips reminded me that account value can fall even when I do nothing; I should judge risk against my long-term plan, not treat each decline as a signal to act.","Since I check infrequently and trade rarely, I should review my holdings and cash deliberately at set intervals rather than make rushed decisions based on short-term price moves."]}
